##### Project general facts
Farm Gardens Villas 2 at The Valley is a gated villa community by Emaar Properties, shaped around the character of a traditional desert farm. The design pairs rustic, country-style simplicity with contemporary comfort, giving each home privacy while keeping open green space close at hand. The collection consists of four- and five-bedroom villas offered in a choice of distinct architectural styles. Architectural detailing runs across the elevations, and the floor plans are arranged for families who want generous living areas in a quiet, landscape-led setting.

The shared amenities form an outdoor programme spread through landscaped grounds. For wellness, residents have a yoga platform, a reflexology path and themed gardens with an aviary. Leisure spaces include a floating deck, amphitheatre steps and an events lawn suited to community gatherings. Families have a dedicated play area and shaded picnic spots, while the sports offer covers paddle tennis, bocce ball and a putting green. A community centre adds swimming pools designed for residents of all ages, so everyday recreation stays inside the gated grounds.

Inside, the villas follow the same rustic-meets-contemporary theme as the exteriors. Interiors are planned to be intuitive in use, combining architectural detailing with modern amenities, and the separate exterior styles give buyers a choice of character for their home.

##### Location description and benefits
The Valley is an Emaar master community on the outskirts of Dubai, set along Dubai-Al Ain Road in an area known for its desert farmland. The community is planned as a largely self-contained neighbourhood of villas and townhouses. Its Town Centre gathers cafés, boutique shops, alfresco dining and a supermarket, while Golden Beach offers sandy shores and calm water. The Sports Village provides courts and playgrounds, and Kids Dale and a network of pocket parks add family play areas and picnic spots across the community.

Dubai-Al Ain Road gives direct driving access to central Dubai, with Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina and Dubai International Airport all reachable by car. Private vehicles are the main way to get around. For education, Ranches Primary School and the campuses of Dubai Academic City serve the area, and healthcare is available through Dubai London Clinic and Health Hub Clinic. Arabian Ranches is among the established communities nearby. Jogging trails, outdoor fitness zones and a gym support an active, outdoor lifestyle.

The Valley appeals to buyers looking for suburban villa living at a calmer pace than the central districts. Its gated format, extensive open space and in-community retail and leisure suit end users with families, while the road link to central Dubai supports demand from households working in the city. With Emaar as master developer, the community follows a single planning vision, which keeps its landscaped character consistent across neighbourhoods.
